'''2014 Alderaan Regionals Nathan LS Communing''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Nathan]] at [[2014 Alderaan Regionals]] (Regionals).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Communing (Virtual Block 7)|Communing]]
* '''Username:''' SolaGratia
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Regionals
